post.summary: Import an exported offline data package
post.description: Imports a zip written by a native device that could not sync, on behalf of the signed-in member. The whole package is validated and every inspection in it is authorized for the caller before anything is written, so a package that names one inspection the caller may not edit changes nothing. Importing the same package again is safe and reports its queued writes as skipped. Requires a Content-Length header.

applied.description: Queued writes executed by this import

skipped.description: Queued writes that had already been applied

status.description: HTTP status the target route refused it with, or 424 when it was not attempted because of reason

reason.description: Present when the write was not attempted: blocked_by_failed_update means an earlier queued update to the same inspection was refused, and completing the inspection without it would finish work the device never delivered. Later versions may add values; a client treats an unknown reason as "not attempted" and keeps the entry

failed.description: Queued writes the server refused. The results and photos in the package were still imported; these entries need attention on the device.

unchanged.description: Inspections whose results were already up to date

details.description: Optional structured context for the error, such as per-field validation failures.

error.description: Error detail; present only when the request failed.

meta.description: Optional response metadata, such as pagination information.

400.description: The package is malformed, names something outside its manifest, or holds an entry whose bytes do not match the size its directory declares

403.description: The package belongs to another workspace, or the caller cannot edit one of its inspections

409.description: PACKAGE_INSPECTION_DELETED: the package would create an inspection that an earlier import created and that has since been deleted; nothing was written. Also a CONFLICT whose details.reason is idempotency_in_flight: a queued write is being run by another request right now, so the import stopped and should be retried exactly as for a 5xx; writes already applied are skipped on the retry

413.description: PACKAGE_TOO_LARGE or BAD_REQUEST: the package exceeds the byte limit; details.limits names the limits

422.description: PACKAGE_TOO_LARGE: the package has more inspections, queued writes, photos or entries than this server imports at once; nothing was written. details names the limit and details.limits the sizes to split to. PACKAGE_EXPIRED: the package was exported more than details.maxAgeDays days ago; nothing was written. PACKAGE_FROM_THE_FUTURE: the package says it was exported more than details.maxFutureSkewDays day ahead of the server clock; nothing was written

patch.description: Partially update an inspection record. Available to owner, manager and inspector roles; changing the assigned inspector requires the scheduleOthers capability (owner and manager have it by default), and so does changing the date of an inspection the caller is not on (lead or helper); an inspector on the inspection can change its date, and may edit other fields. Staff may change the order fields (date, assigned inspector, price, address, reference and referral fields, closing date, payment and agreement requirements, and a status of requested, scheduled or confirmed). They may switch the payment and agreement requirements on but not off, may not change the status of a completed inspection, and may change the property details only before the inspection starts. A body changing any report setting or other inspection field gets 403, and so do changes to the inspector, address or date after the inspection has started. Staff writes need scheduleOthers or being on the inspection.
